questions.question: What is the difference between the JORC Code and NI 43-101?

facts: both are public reporting standards for mineral resources and reserves; JORC is Australasian and NI 43-101 is Canadian
both require a Competent Person (JORC) or Qualified Person (NI 43-101) to sign off the technical information
they use broadly similar resource and reserve categories (inferred, indicated, measured; probable, proved) and are aligned through CRIRSCO, with differences in details such as disclosure rules
truth.tolerance: the key points must be present and correct; extra correct detail is fine
truth.source: general knowledge, written before any system was asked

questions.question: Why is most cobalt produced as a by-product?

facts: most cobalt is recovered as a by-product of copper (notably in the DRC) and nickel mining
so cobalt supply depends on copper and nickel production decisions more than on the cobalt price
this makes supply less responsive to cobalt price changes and adds supply-risk and price-volatility concerns
truth.tolerance: the key points must be present and correct; extra correct detail is fine
truth.source: general knowledge, written before any system was asked

questions.question: Why are heavy rare earths like dysprosium and terbium more valuable than the light ones?

facts: they are much less abundant in most deposits than the light rare earths
they are needed to keep NdFeB magnets magnetised at high temperature (coercivity) in motors and generators
supply is concentrated, mainly ionic-adsorption clays in southern China and Myanmar, and separation capacity is limited
truth.tolerance: the key points must be present and correct; extra correct detail is fine

questions.question: How does a porphyry copper deposit form and what grades are typical?

facts: it forms from magmatic-hydrothermal fluids associated with intrusions, typically in subduction-related arcs
it is large tonnage and low grade, typically around 0.3 to 1% copper, with molybdenum and gold as by-products
it has zoned alteration (such as potassic, phyllic and propylitic) around the intrusion
truth.tolerance: the key points must be present and correct; extra correct detail is fine
truth.source: general knowledge, written before any system was asked

questions.question: What is a stream sediment survey used for in mineral exploration?
